TestnetV2 (CCEBVDYM...4HGF).decision: MONITOR-ONLY. The route exists, so the conversion primitives were implemented and unit-tested (dex.QuoteConvertIn / ConvertExactOut with a par-anchored bound), but they are NOT wired into an autonomous capital path. Reason (adversarial review, 3 confirmed critical findings): a Blend user-liquidation fill transfers no tokens - the filler assumes the dToken debt (FACTS.md 'Auction asset flows') - so capital pre-converted to pool-USDC would sit stranded, and a failed fill or a post-send-ambiguous conversion has no sound recovery path. At the pair's ~50-USDC depth every realistic conversion also breaches a 1% par bound anyway. The adapter emits no tasks for a pool whose settle asset differs from the vault's, Execute refuses defensively, and each scan re-quotes the 1-USDC route and reports parity in the pool's scan note.
TestnetV2 (CCEBVDYM...4HGF).config: BLEND_POOLS entry 'CCEBVDYM...:monitor:CAQCFVLO...' (third field declares the pool USDC; any pool whose settle asset != USDC_CONTRACT is execution-disabled regardless of mode)
